entry.title: AI Engineering & Enterprise Agentic Systems
entry.summary: Deep dive into enterprise GenAI, autonomous AI agents, ServiceNow Now Assist Skills, and AI Agent Studio integrations for automated workflows.
entry.content:
Generative AI & Agentic Workflows in Enterprise IT

Pratham Agrawal designs and implements production-grade generative AI and agentic systems within enterprise architectures. Leveraging large language models (LLMs) and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, this work bridges traditional ITSM with autonomous multi-step reasoning.

Key Focus Areas:

  • GenAI & LLM Applications: Production-ready enterprise AI automating complex workflows, generating context-aware summaries, and augmenting human decision-making.
  • Agentic AI & Autonomous Systems: Multi-step autonomous agents that break down complex enterprise incidents, call internal APIs, and execute resolutions with safety guardrails.
  • ServiceNow AI (Now Assist & AI Agent Studio): Native platform conversational AI skills, GenAI skills customization, and agent deployment across enterprise catalog and incident workflows.
  • Enterprise AI Integration: Event-driven architecture connecting AI models with ITSM, ERP, and CRM platforms via REST/SOAP APIs and webhooks.

entry.title: Case Study: Hopa Menu — NFC & SaaS Restaurant Management Platform
entry.summary: Production-grade SaaS and NFC-based restaurant management and food ordering platform engineered for the Israeli market, built with Next.js, Node.js, Express, Firebase, and GCP.
entry.content:
Hopa Menu: Modernizing F&B Operations with Next.js & GCP

A full-stack, contactless digital menu and ordering platform built for high-throughput restaurant environments in Israel.

Impact & Technical Achievements:

  • 30% Performance Boost: Migrated legacy React SPA to Next.js with server-side rendering and edge optimizations.
  • 10% Increase in Customer Engagement: Instant NFC table scanning and streamlined checkout flows.
  • Scalable Cloud Architecture: Powered by Node.js, Express, Firebase real-time database, Google Cloud Platform, and Tailwind CSS.

entry.title: Case Study: SCORM-Based LMS & Educational Platform
entry.summary: Enterprise e-learning architecture engineered across 6 dedicated user interfaces, featuring SCORM compliance, Twilio messaging, WiPay and Razorpay payment gateways.
entry.content:
Scalable E-Learning Platform with Role-Based Interfaces

A comprehensive SCORM-compliant learning management system delivering personal development and mental health education.

System Architecture:

  • 6 Dedicated Role Interfaces: Tailored portals for Students, Teachers, Parents, School Admins, Content Uploaders, and Super Admins.
  • Real-Time Communication: Twilio Conversations integration for 1-on-1 and group student-facilitator discussions with multimedia support.
  • Global Payment Gateways: Seamless multi-currency subscription processing via WiPay and Razorpay.
  • Interactive E-Learning: Embedded SCORM runtime tracking student milestones, completion rates, and performance analytics.
